відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"For an evening at the theatre I chose a polished look, a little dressier than an ordinary outing, because a night at a play deserves it. The pointed pumps lengthen the line of the legs below the wide trousers. The bag's quiet grey-blue sits calmly beside the suit's blue. The kerchief and earrings gather the attention near your face, where the evening look should be. The blazer and trousers form one long vertical line, and the belted coat keeps a clear waist anchor so the volume never reads as shapeless.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"On the way in, tie the coat's belt firmly at the waist. It is the anchor that keeps the wide trousers and long blazer from losing your figure.\",\"Once the coat is off, fasten the blazer on its single button so the waist stays marked inside the theatre.\",\"Knot the kerchief loosely at the neck so it shows under the blazer's lapels, bringing its light blue and yellow close to your face.\"],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#224·05\",\"what\":\"blazer and wide trousers of the suit\"},{\"n\":\"#348·01\",\"what\":\"belted coat\"},{\"n\":\"#243·17\",\"what\":\"pointed pumps\"},{\"n\":\"#310·07\",\"what\":\"bag\"},{\"n\":\"#183·14\",\"what\":\"kerchief\"},{\"n\":\"#315·35\",\"what\":\"earrings\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#224·05\",\"text\":\"A suit gives you a finished, dressed-up look for the theatre in one step. Its long blazer and wide trousers draw one long vertical line, which suits your straight, softly defined waist.\"},{\"n\":\"#348·01\",\"text\":\"The coat is your outer layer for arriving and leaving in the evening. Its own belt gives the waist anchor that the volume of the rest of the outfit needs, and I kept it for the richer, evening-ready depth of its colour.\"},{\"n\":\"#243·17\",\"text\":\"Pointed pumps with a low heel are a dressy choice that fits a theatre evening. The pointed toe stretches the leg line below the wide hems.\"},{\"n\":\"#310·07\",\"text\":\"A slim shoulder bag is a tidy, evening-appropriate size for a play. Its muted grey-blue is calm enough to echo the blue of the suit without competing.\"},{\"n\":\"#183·14\",\"text\":\"The kerchief brings its light blue and yellow close to your face, where colour works best. It is the one playful note in an otherwise restrained evening look.\"},{\"n\":\"#315·35\",\"text\":\"The earrings add a small dark sparkle at the ear, which suits an evening out. They stay modest, so your face remains the focus.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":19518,"output_tokens":2715},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
